subject: microbiology
title: Systemic and opportunistic mycoses

steps.tx: **Aspergillus fumigatus** (septate hyphae with **acute angle branching**, fruiting bodies in cavities) diseases by immunity: **allergic bronchopulmonary aspergillosis** (asthma with fleeting shadows, high IgE, central bronchiectasis, steroids with itraconazole), **aspergilloma** (fungus ball in old TB cavity with haemoptysis, air crescent, resection or embolisation), **invasive aspergillosis** (neutropenia, halo sign nodules, **galactomannan** positive, **voriconazole** first line). Culture with KOH and biopsy proves; **septate versus mucor broad aseptate** splits therapy instantly.
steps.say: Acute branching septate hyphae are Aspergillus: galactomannan in neutropenia, voriconazole. Ball in old cavity bleeds: aspergilloma.

vis.alt: Composite image showing Aspergillus fumigatus microscopy (septate hyphae, acute branching) and CT scans of aspergilloma (air crescent) and invasive aspergillosis (halo sign).
vis.caption: Aspergillus fumigatus: microscopy, aspergilloma (air crescent), and invasive aspergillosis (halo sign)

steps.tx: **Mucormycosis** (broad **aseptate hyphae with right angle branching**, Rhizopus thriving in **diabetic ketoacidosis** and post COVID steroids) invades vessels necrosing tissue: **rhino orbital cerebral** (black turbinate with facial pain, ophthalmoplegia, cavernous thrombosis), pulmonary and cutaneous forms. Management is **liposomal amphotericin B** with urgent **surgical debridement** and sugar control; posaconazole or isavuconazole steps down. Do not confuse with aspergillus (voriconazole fails mucor); biopsy with frozen section decides within hours.
steps.say: Black turbinate in DKA is mucor: amphotericin plus knife, not voriconazole. Broad aseptate right angles prove.

steps.tx: **Candida albicans** (pseudohyphae with **germ tubes**, chlamydospores) colonises then invades lines and guts: **oesophageal candidiasis** (AIDS dysphagia, white plaques bleeding on scrape, **fluconazole**), vulvovaginitis (diabetes, single dose fluconazole), **candidaemia** (TPN, broad antibiotics, remove lines, **echinocandin** then step down, fundoscopy with echo for seeding). **Cryptococcus neoformans** (capsulated budding yeast, **India ink** halos, pigeon droppings, **cryptococcal meningitis** in AIDS with high pressure headaches, **CrAg lateral flow**, amphotericin plus flucytosine induction) completes yeasts.
steps.say: White plaques bleeding on scrape in AIDS is candida oesophagitis: fluconazole. Capsuled yeast meningitis is crypto: ampho plus flucytosine.

steps.tx: **Pneumocystis jirovecii** (cysts, **ground glass with pneumatoceles**, CD4 under 200, exertional desaturation with raised LDH, **TMP-SMX** treatment and prophylaxis, steroids in hypoxia) is prevented by cotrimoxazole. **Dimorphics** (mould in soil, yeast in tissue): **Histoplasma** (Ohio Mississippi, bat caves, calcified nodes, itraconazole), **Coccidioides** (desert Southwest, spherules with endospores, erythema nodosum), **Blastomyces** (broad based budding, skin and prostate), **Paracoccidioides** (pilot wheel, Latin America), **Talaromyces marneffei** (AIDS Southeast Asia, umbilicated papules).
steps.say: Ground glass under CD4 200 is Pneumocystis: cotrimoxazole plus steroids if hypoxic. Dimorphics switch shape with temperature.
